title: The login of the sample shop
audience: Developers who are new to the codebase

questions.q: How many characters long is the session id the server sends in the cookie?
How many bytes long is the random salt of each stored password?
What happens to the sessions of the shop when the server restarts?
options: They survive: they are stored in the database
Every user is logged out: sessions live only in memory
They survive: they are stored in the cookie
Only the sessions older than an hour are lost

questions.q: A login arrives with an email that does not exist. What does the shop answer?
options: 404 saying that the email is unknown
401 with the same message as for a wrong password
400 saying that the email is invalid

questions.q: How does the shop compare the key derived from the typed password with the stored one?
options: With ===, which stops at the first different byte
In constant time, so the time taken does not reveal how much matched
By asking the database to compare them
